title: Neverending onbroarding and no app support
body: App downloaded, went through a questionnaire that took WAY too long, only for the app to demand a signature it won’t allow me to provide. Went to report the issue through the link in the app store and it just goes to an ad, not anything actually helpful. I might’ve paid for this, if I could have seen literally anything past the questionnaire.

title: Forced default habits and long on boarding
body: The on-boarding took way too long only to have me select pre-defined habits that I didn’t want. I downloaded the app with a specific habit but couldn’t add that habit until after the on-boarding was done, add at least 2 habits AND click through a guided walkthrough of the app.
author: JAndlauer

title: Love this as part of my routine
body:
Please developers change the colour coding for the various habits and habit colour coded days, make them pop more or a deeper shade. The colours are too dull/light. I can literally code this for you hire me, also an option to integrate w Apple Music or Spotify while going through your checklists in the timer mode , or even smart timer mode where it suggests options or smart feedback based on the habits you’re doing

Love this app and I feel like I could use a richer feature set, :)
